summary: Itasca County tower in the Chippewa National Forest, described in 1959 survey notes; bids to sell it opened in June 1972, it was removed in 1973, and no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Four-legged, self-supporting steel tower with an observation room at the top; 85 feet overall (1959 survey notes)
facts.status_note: Sold in 1972 and removed in 1973 per the A-Z tower list; no source describes what remains at the site today

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts page records bids for the sale of the tower in June 1972; the A-Z list says it was sold in 1972 and removed in 1973. These fit together: sold in 1972, taken down by 1973.

sources.title: Minnesota fire lookout towers, A-Z list

notes_for_editor: No build year appears in any source read, so the story starts at the 1959 survey and says nothing about construction. Staffing is not in any source. The Forest Lookouts page gives 149N-26W-24 as the township, range and section, but its quoted 1959 NGS text places the station in 'T. 60 N., R. 36 W.', which does not match; the story does not use either legal location. Record lat/long (47.7146, -93.91824) agrees with the FFLA list; the A-Z list gives 47.7143, -93.9183, within rounding. The 85 ft figure is an overall height (A-Z list: 'The overall height is 85 feet'), so it is in design and not in height_m. The access level is left out because no source describes access. Two WebSearch-equivalent queries and about four page reads.
